messages:
Maya Patel: quick heads up — rc-hotpatch build is green. Need 2x LGTM before 23:00 UTC cutoff. pinging night-owl rotation. @Linus @Jordan please?
Linus Kwan: on it, can review in ~20m. is the rollout plan identical to last week or any extra steps? :eyes:
Maya Patel: no DB changes. just a kv-cache safety flag and a tiny perf tweak. plan: canary 5% -> 30m -> gradual shift. auto-fallback to stable if error spike. will attach smoke checklist in PR.
Jordan Lee: scanning now. quick perf question — can we run a short 10m 600seq pass? if green i'll give LGTM.
Olivia Park: i've queued two perf runs already (CI shows in the PR). both within baseline; kicking a 600seq quick-run now. (reaction :eyes: by Olivia Park)
release-bot: Reminder: merge cutoff at 23:00 UTC. Release: rc-hotpatch-2024. Deploy window opens at 23:15 UTC.
Linus Kwan: LGTM — one non-blocking nit about a log message (left inline).
Jordan Lee: LGTM. :thumbsup:
Maya Patel: great, that's 2x. @sre-oncall can you standby for canary monitoring + rollback if needed?
sre-oncall: on standby. rollback command ready:
```
rctl deploy --env=prod --id=rc-hotpatch-2024 --rollback-to=stable
```
Monitoring checks i'll watch: 
- errors: sum(rate(http_errors[5m])) > 3% -> alert
- latency P95: > baseline + 100ms -> manual check
Ping me immediately if alerts fire.
Maya Patel: plan is to merge at 23:02 UTC (short buffer), trigger deploy at 23:05 so canary starts 23:15. i'll post status updates here. thanks everyone :rocket:
Linus Kwan: small follow-up PR coming to fix that log typo — not blocking deploy.
release-bot: Deploy triggered by Maya Patel at 23:05 UTC. Canary 5% started at 23:15 UTC.
Maya Patel: monitoring status @ 23:25 UTC — canary healthy, no error spike, latency stable. beginning gradual rollout. will confirm when fully shifted.
Jordan Lee: thanks for the quick turnaround, team. catching zzz after shift — ping if anything odd. :coffee:
